sections.title: What's New
items: Daylight Mirror is built in, so you can show your Mac or PC screen on your DC-1 over USB-C or Wi-Fi.
A new Software Update app replaces Software Updates: find it in your apps or in Settings > System, and install an update with one tap.
Tap Release Notes in Software Update to see what's new in each update.
Update reminders wait until your battery is at least 20% or your tablet is charging.
The Daylight Store app is now on your tablet, where you can get the latest Daylight Mirror.
Use a USB webcam for video calls in apps such as Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams.
See the battery level of a connected Bluetooth keyboard or mouse in Settings.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Kindle is updated to version 8.157, and your books and sign-in carry over.
Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams from the Play Store can use your camera and microphone on your first call without asking, and you can still turn this off in Settings.
The screen now refreshes between 45 and 90 Hz by default.
Pictures now show as apps draw them, without the tablet's built-in color and sharpening effects.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed Zoom asking for USB access to the webcam, which could stop the webcam until you unplugged it.
Fixed the camera in Google Meet and Microsoft Teams taking several seconds to start and failing on the first try.
